newsitem.title: AFGHANISTAN: Opposition Afghan jet drops bomb near Kabul palace.
newsitem.headline: Opposition Afghan jet drops bomb near Kabul palace.

text.p: An Afghan opposition jet dropped a bomb near the presidential palace in the capital Kabul on Thursday, witnesses said.
It was not immediately known if there were any casualties from the bombing, which drew anti-aircraft fire from the fighters of the Taleban militia.
The palace houses the defence ministry of the Taleban movement government, which is fighting a northern alliance of opposition factions.
No other details were immediately available.
